paper.citation: Liebana Garcia S., Laffere A., et al. (2025). Dopamine encodes deep network teaching signals for individual learning trajectories. Cell 188, 3789-3805.e33.

claims.description: Figure 1G Pearson correlation between mean zero-contrast bias over paper days 4-8 and mean zero-contrast bias over the final five paper-day indices.
claims.tolerance_rationale: The paper prints the correlation to two decimal places; +/-0.01 covers rounding of the printed value and nothing more.

claims.description: Figure 1G significance statement, reported in the paper as an inequality rather than a point value.
claims.tolerance_rationale: The paper reports p < 0.01, so the only checkable content is that the reproduced p-value stays below the printed bound.
